verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Checkout.com offering user-configurable automations or workflows that run on their own in the background. The closest items are adjacent: webhooks are event notifications a developer could build on, risk rules are fraud-specific controls, the AI-driven acceptance optimization is a vendor-run feature, and the MCP server is used interactively from an IDE. None of these is the story's capability, so none earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
